title: Daphnia magna: DNA extraction for downstream whole genome NGS
author: Albano Pinto
materials: Set the Nanodrop spectrophotometer software for nucleic acids assessment

steps.title: Prepare lysis solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL Proteinase K (50 µg/µL) into 300 µL Tissue and Cell Lysis Solution per sample.

steps.title: Add lysis solution and grind
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL Tissue and Cell Lysis Solution with Proteinase K to each tube containing the daphnid sample, then grind the daphnids with a pestle.

steps.title: Add additional lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add a further 150 µL Tissue and Cell Lysis Solution with Proteinase K to each tube and mix by inverting several times.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 65 °C for 15 min in a thermoblock, vortexing every 5 min to mix.

steps.title: Cool to 37 °C
steps.instruction: Cool the tubes to 37 °C.

steps.title: Incubate at 50 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 50 °C for 3 h in the thermoblock.

steps.title: Ice incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Add protein precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL MPC protein precipitation solution (kit supplied) to each tube and vortex for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C for 10 min at 10 000 × g.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the pellet without disturbing it and transfer the supernatant to new sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 99.5 % molecular‑biology‑grade isopropanol (Thermo Fisher Catalog #327272500) to each tube, mix by gently inverting 40 times.

steps.title: Centrifuge second spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C for 10 min at 13 000 rpm.

steps.title: Remove isopropanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the isopropanol supernatant with a micropipette, taking care not to disturb the pellet; centrifuge 10 s at room temperature, then remove remaining supernatant with a small‑bore tip and verify that a white DNA pellet is visible.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (×2)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL refrigerated 70 % ethanol (user‑contributed) gently to avoid lifting the pellet, spin down at 4 °C if the pellet is loose, discard the ethanol with a micropipette; repeat this wash two times.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the DNA pellet at room temperature with tube lids open for 30 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 35–37 µL autoclaved ultrapure water to each pellet, then incubate at 4 °C for 30 min to aid resuspension.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase A (5 µg/µL, kit supplied) to each sample, mix by inverting several times, then spin down the tubes.

steps.title: Quantify DNA by fluorometry
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1–20 µL aliquot of each sample (commonly 2 µL), add the Qubit dsDNA BR/HS reagent to reach a final volume of 200 µL, dilute if necessary, read fluorescence on the Qubit and record concentration (expected 5–10 ng/µL for reference samples).

steps.title: Spectrophotometric quality check
steps.instruction: Measure total nucleic‑acid concentration (expected 150–300 ng/µL), 260/280 absorbance ratio (~1.8–1.9 target), and 260/230 ratio (target 2.0–2.2, typical 1.7–1.9); repeat the read at least once for consistency.

steps.title: Load sample for Qubit reading
steps.instruction: Pipette 2 µL of the sample into the Qubit holder (no dilution needed for reference biomass).

steps.title: Prepare 0.8 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 0.8 % agarose gel stained with Invitrogen SYBR Safe DNA Gel Stain according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load samples with appropriate loading dye, run the gel at 100 V for 30 min in 1× TBE buffer (10× TBE diluted to 1×), including a GeneRuler 1 kb Plus DNA ladder (Catalog #SM1331) in the first well.

steps.title: Image gel
steps.instruction: Transfer the gel to a documentation system and capture the band pattern; intact high‑molecular‑weight DNA should appear near the top of the gel above the 10 kb ladder band.

steps.title: Aliquot DNA for QC
steps.instruction: Aliquot approximately 15 µL of each DNA sample for downstream quality‑control checks.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at –80 °C for long‑term storage or at 4 °C for short‑term preservation before further steps.
